item.title: Zach Bryan Gets Married
item.description: Zach Bryan and Samantha Leonard were recently married. A short video posted by the outlet appears to show Bryan carrying Leonard, both wearing sunglasses, to a convertible decked with “Just Married” bunting and the happy couple driving away. A rep for the artist did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Deryck Whibley Gives Life Update
item.description: Deryck Whibley gave a recent health update on Instagram: As of this year, I’m proud to say that with a lot of work and major lifestyle changes, my body is now operating almost 8 years younger than my actual age. My arteries are as clear as 16 year old!
